If his brother is from Japan and he is just coming for a holiday (with a return ticket) then it is pretty unlikely that he will have problems at the border. The only thing is that he needs to make sure that he has an ETA-IL. You can read more about that here - make sure you use the correct site (linked to in the article) and not a scam site: https://aic.org.il/eta-il-how-to-apply-and-everything-you-need-to-know-guide/

To be extra sure to avoid troubles, you or your husband could have invited him on a tourist visa through PIBA, but that needs to be done at least 20 days in advance - so you are out of time now unfortunately. But really I wouldn't worry too much.
